environments.local: Everything runs and is verified in the local sandbox.
environments.remote: Needs a public URL, persistent process, GPU, secrets, or real infrastructure; build locally, deploy, verify the live target.
environments.hybrid: Build and test locally, deploy a part (usually the backend or the bot) remotely, verify both.

common_axes.anchor: 10 = every requested feature works end to end on the real thing, no stubs, no fake data
10 = edge cases, bad input, and failure paths are handled; adversarial probing found nothing
10 = clear structure, tests that catch real bugs, no dead code, a maintainer would be happy
10 = measured, fast, and no obvious waste for this kind of product
10 = scanners clean, inputs validated, secrets safe, least privilege
10 = a stranger can run, use, and extend it from the README alone

web-ui.description: Static or client-side website, landing page, SPA, dashboard, visual explainer.
web-ui.observe: Screenshot desktop and mobile with `forge shot` and LOOK at them; check console/network errors; run lighthouse and axe; exercise interactions with playwright.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = indistinguishable from a top design studio's work: hierarchy, spacing, type, motion, all states
10 = axe clean, keyboard-complete, sensible contrast and focus

fullstack-web.description: Web app with a backend, database, auth, or deployment.
fullstack-web.observe: Playwright user flows against the running app; HTTP checks against the API; DB state inspection; for remote, verify the live URL.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = top-studio quality UI with every state designed

api.observe: Contract tests from the OpenAPI schema; schemathesis fuzzing; load test with autocannon/k6; inspect logs and DB state; verify the live URL if deployed.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = consistent, documented, versioned, errors are structured and helpful

cli-lib.observe: Run the commands with real inputs and read stdout/stderr/exit codes; test suite with coverage; try bad inputs and --help.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = great defaults, clear errors, excellent --help, composable

bot.description: Long-running bot or automation (trading, chat, scraping, scheduled jobs).
bot.observe: ALWAYS paper/sandbox mode; replay historical data; inspect logs for a sustained run; test restart/crash recovery and rate-limit handling; for remote, check uptime and logs over SSH.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = survives disconnects, restarts, rate limits, partial fills; state is recoverable; kill switch exists

bot.safety: Never enable live trading or real-money actions. Default to paper mode and require an explicit human config change for live.

mobile.observe: Build the app; run in an emulator; screenshots and logcat via adb; Maestro flows. iOS needs macOS: if unavailable, say so and verify the web/Expo build instead.

systems.description: C/C++/Rust/Go systems software, engines, compilers, protocols.
systems.observe: Compile with warnings as errors; run tests under ASan/UBSan/TSan; valgrind; benchmark with hyperfine/Google Benchmark; fuzz parsers.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = sanitizers and valgrind clean under tests and fuzzing

embedded.observe: Build with PlatformIO; run in QEMU/Renode emulation or host-side unit tests; static analysis.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = static analysis clean, bounded memory, no UB

data-ml.description: Data pipeline, analysis, notebook, or ML model.
data-ml.observe: Profile and validate data; plot results to images and look at them; assert metrics against thresholds; reproducibility check.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = one command reproduces results; seeds, versions, and data lineage are pinned

game.observe: Headless run; scripted input; screenshots over time; frame-time sampling; check for softlocks and invalid states.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = responsive controls, clear feedback, juicy, balanced, no dead ends

media.observe: ffprobe the output; extract frames and look at them; transcribe audio and compare with the script; check sync, duration, loudness.

desktop.observe: Run under Xvfb; scripted input with xdotool; screenshot with scrot; check packaging.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = native-quality UI with every state designed

docs.description: Documentation site, guide, or written deliverable.
docs.observe: Build the site; check links with lychee; lint prose; render and look at pages; verify every code sample actually runs.

extra_axes.anchor: 10 = accurate, complete, skimmable, every example runs

design.description: Visual design, brand assets, UI mockups as code.
design.observe: Render and screenshot at several sizes; compare against reference products; check contrast and spacing.
